Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Zaid al-Rifai was born in Safed (Mandatory Palestine). The information found by the WebSurfer indicated that Zaid al-Rifai was born in Amman, Jordan, as stated by multiple sources, including Roya News and xwhos.com. The Planner mistakenly interpreted the birthplace information of Samir al-Rifai, Zaid's father, as belonging to Zaid al-Rifai, leading to the wrong conclusion.
